text.tspan: Layer cache: one change rebuilds that layer and everything after it
Same trap: RUN apt-get update on its own line is cached forever → always apt-get update && apt-get install in one RUN.
Deleting files in a later RUN doesn't shrink the image: the earlier layer still holds them.
